NAMING-001.summary: Write package names as lowercase words run together.
NAMING-001.details: Keep package names in lowercase with no underscores or camel case; the same holds for identifiers.
NAMING-001.rationale: A package name appears at every external reference, so inconsistent naming keeps raising the reading cost.

COMMENT-001.summary: Comment only what the code cannot express.
COMMENT-001.details: Use comments to state the intent and the constraints rather than restating what the code does.
COMMENT-001.rationale: A comment that restates the code goes stale as the code changes, an identifier rename being the clearest case.
